reply: For Session 2 2026, late enrolment applications open 10 August and close 12 August 2026. The census date for standard Session 2 units is 21 August 2026: it is the last day to withdraw without paying fees. Some units have different census dates, so check your own units. For help, contact Service Connect.

Session 2 2026 fees are due by Friday 24 July 2026; a $150 late payment fee applies after that date. If you are eligible for a HELP loan, you must defer your fees through HELP by the census date, 21 August 2026. Check your own amounts and dates in My Total Debts.

If a serious and unavoidable event affects an assessment, apply for Special Consideration online through the Service Connect portal no later than 5 working days after the due date, and include supporting evidence. The university aims to give an outcome within 5 working days. For some assessments you can instead request a Short Extension of up to 3 calendar days, with no evidence needed, before the original due date.

In Session 2 2026 the Waranara Library is open to students Monday to Friday 8am to midnight, Saturday 10am to midnight and Sunday 9am to midnight (staff available weekdays 8am to 8pm). From Monday 26 October to Friday 27 November, Levels 3, 4 and 5 are open 24/7: tap in with your campus card.

Password resets are done through Microsoft self-service at password.mq.edu.au; have your MFA device ready. If you have lost your MFA device, contact the IT Service Desk straight away. The Service Desk is at the TechBar, Ground Floor, 18 Wally's Walk, phone +61 2 9850 4357 (HELP), or log a ticket any time through OneHelp.

The Session 2 2026 final exam timetable was released on 14 October 2026 on the Exam Scheduler (iexams.mq.edu.au); room and seat details follow on 4 November. The exam period is 9 to 27 November 2026. A clash means two exams overlap or have less than one hour between them on the same day; the Examinations Office will notify you of the arrangements. Misreading the timetable is not grounds for Special Consideration.
